metadata.task_goal: Resolve the current correction-insulin workflow using the active glucose record, meal status, and signed correction scale.

files./workspace/ehr/request.txt:
REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-1601
The bedside team requests review of a correction insulin dose before the evening meal. Reference: GLU-V3-1601.
files./workspace/ehr/current_record.txt:
CURRENT RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-1601
Capillary glucose at 17:40 is 268 mg/dL. The meal tray is present and the patient confirms intent to eat. The administration record shows glargine 18 units given at 08:00 and no rapid-acting insulin since noon.
files./workspace/ehr/protocol.txt:
SIGNED CORRECTION SCALE
For PAT-V3-1601, glucose 251–300 mg/dL immediately before a meal corresponds to insulin lispro 6 units subcutaneously once, with a repeat glucose check two hours later. The scale is signed at 07:10 for this encounter.
files./workspace/ehr/laboratory_note.txt:
LABORATORY NOTE
The 17:40 glucose was obtained by bedside meter and quality-control status is current. A 15:30 serum glucose was 212 mg/dL.
files./workspace/ehr/procedure.md:
WORKSPACE NOTE
The workspace contains a request, active medication state, meal information, glucose measurements, and signed protocol material. Source timing and clinical relevance may differ.
